blk_part_01_part_1_old_emoticons_are_sti.text: Before emoji became common, people made faces from keyboard symbols. These are called emoticons. A face such as :-) is read sideways, while XD shows strong laughter. They became popular in early email, forums, and chat rooms. They may look old now, but they have not disappeared. Emoticons that people still use in other countries include the Russian closing bracket, XD in gaming chats, and <3 in nostalgic messages.

blk_part_02_part_2_emoji_meanings_can_tr.text: For example, 🙏 can express thanks, a request, or an apology in Japan. Elsewhere, people may understand it mainly as prayer, and some users call it a high five. The face 😤 also shows change. Its steam originally suggested triumph or determination in a Japanese visual tradition, but many international users now read it as anger or frustration.
